drawer.callConfirmBody: You talk to {who} from this campaign's number ({number}) using your microphone. Keep this tab open. It does not use up a step of the sequence.
drawer.aiCallConfirmBody: The AI agent places a real WhatsApp call to {phone} from this campaign's number, with the campaign's instructions{own, select, yes { and this lead's own} other {}}. It does not use up a step of the sequence.
drawer.aiCallStarted: Calling from {number} — it starts as soon as the number is free.
drawer.tryCallBody: Rehearse talks to the agent in your browser as if you were {name}: their name, company, history and the instructions below. Call now places a real WhatsApp call to them from the campaign's number with you on the line, through your microphone; AI call has the agent make it instead. Both are recorded and transcribed.
drawer.saveFirst: Save the instructions below first so the rehearsal uses them.
drawer.instructionsHint: Only for calls to {name}, on top of the campaign's: who referred them, what they care about, what to avoid.
drawer.instructionsPlaceholder: Met Asha at the Mumbai D2C meetup; she mentioned their ads are all going to one product page.
drawer.noActivity: No calls or messages with {name} yet.{queued, select, yes { The first step runs once the campaign is launched and a number is free.} other {}}
drawer.callRepFromNumber: Call by a rep (from the calling number)

leads.requeueFailed: Could not queue the lead again
leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Everyone in this campaign and where they are in the sequence.
leads.emptyBody: Import a spreadsheet with phone numbers, or add people from your lead database.

overview.everyoneReached: Everyone has been reached out to
overview.callsTodayHint: Calls this campaign placed today, against the most its numbers may place a day (their own limit or the Sending rule; a number still warming up places fewer).
overview.answeredHint: Calls that were picked up and recorded.
overview.conversationsHint: Calls where the lead actually talked. Picking up and saying nothing does not count.
overview.interestedHint: Leads whose call ended interested, meeting agreed, or wanting the team to call.
overview.handedToTeam: {count, plural, one {{shown} handed to the team} other {{shown} handed to the team}}
overview.messagesSent: {count, plural, one {{shown} message sent} other {{shown} messages sent}}
overview.bookedHint: Meetings Cal.com reported. Leads handed to the team are in Action required.
overview.standDescription: Every lead, by where it is now.
overview.noLeadsHint: Add leads to see where they stand.
overview.funnelDescription: How many leads got to each step of the sequence.
overview.perDayDescription: Calls placed each day for the last 14 days, answered or not.
overview.notAnsweredNote: {count, plural, one {# call was not answered or not recorded.} other {# calls were not answered or not recorded.}}

settings.goalDescription: The goal decides what the agent agrees to when a lead is interested.
settings.instructionsHint: What every call in this campaign is about, on top of the Knowledge above: who you are calling, what you offer them, what to find out. Each call step can add its own instructions on top.
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: You are calling founders of D2C brands who run Meta ads. We help them … Find out whether they spend more than ₹5 lakh a month on ads …
settings.agentDescription: How the agent introduces itself. Every call in this campaign uses the same name and voice, so a lead hears one person.
settings.bookingDescription: Where interested leads book a time with your team (a Cal.com page), and the WhatsApp that sends them there right after the call.
settings.bookingHint: Must include {bookingLink}. You can also use {firstName}, {company} and {agentName}.
settings.callbacksDescription: When a lead asks to be called later, the agent calls back at the time they gave.
settings.callbacksHint: After the last one, a person takes the lead over.
settings.numbersDescription: Every lead is called, and messaged, from one of these and keeps hearing from the same one.
settings.numbersFooter: Daily limits, gaps and calling hours are the organization's Sending rules, which each number can override in Settings → WhatsApp → Calling numbers.
settings.pauseDescription: Pausing stops new calls and messages; leads keep their place. Archiving removes the campaign from the list.
settings.draftNote: This campaign is a draft; launch it from the header once it is ready.
